description: Get the ground elevation at a latitude/longitude within the US, from the USGS Elevation Point Query Service. Returns elevation in feet and meters.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 39.5883. US coverage only (USGS).

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, negative in the western hemisphere, e.g. -105.6438.

name: elevation
title: Elevation
